description: Returns the application questions for the dental practice insurance policies a practice owner wants (property and general liability, workers comp, cyber, employment practices, employee theft), grouped by section with answer options and formats, so the owner can answer them in this chat. Use with save_practice_insurance_application to fill out the application here. A few carrier statements, the tax ID, document uploads, and the signature are done on dentalunlock.com and are listed in the result.

coverage.description: Policies to apply for: bop (property and general liability), wc (workers comp), cyber, epli (employment practices), crime (employee theft). Solo practices (no employees) skip wc, epli, and crime.

team_size.description: Employees besides the dentist: solo, 1_3, 4_9, or 10_plus.

name: get_practice_insurance_questions
title: Dental practice insurance application questions
